arguments.command: cd /workspace && for a in "" "big"; do echo "=== $a"; /usr/bin/time -v python3 -I -B submission/main.py < /workspace/tmp/stress$a.json > /workspace/tmp/out$a.json 2> /workspace/tmp/err$a.txt; tail -c 300 /workspace/tmp/out$a.json | head -c 100; echo; ls -la /workspace/tmp/out$a.json; grep -E "Elapsed|Maximum resident" /workspace/tmp/err$a.txt; done
